_comment: Shared skill slug rule (T22). Byte-identical copies live at communicator/tests/fixtures/skill_slug_cases.json and backend/tests/fixtures/skill_slug_cases.json. 'derived' is the backend slug_rules.derived_skill_slug result (empty when nothing usable remains); the daemon's skill_slug_of_record returns 'new-skill' in place of an empty result.

cases.why: an existing slug is a fixed point
punctuation is dropped, underscore becomes a hyphen
dotted capital I lowercases to i plus a combining dot, which is dropped
spaces around dropped punctuation collapse to one hyphen
underscores and whitespace runs become one hyphen
edge hyphens and whitespace are trimmed
no Latin letters or digits: empty
clamp to 64 then trim the trailing hyphen
